Return probes

          
Two probes are supply/return on the manifold. Eight probes give zones 1–6 return sensors 3–8 (the manifold keeps 1 and 2). Live readings show each probe so you can check wiring.
Read more

          
Probe layout

          
2 probes: supply/return on the manifold only. 8 probes: zones 1–6 default to probes 3–8; the manifold keeps 1 (supply) and 2 (return).

BLE clock

            
When enabled, V6 emits Shelly Date/Time Broadcast about every 2 seconds concurrently with BLE scan. BLU displays typically sync once per day; “Sync now” refreshes the beacon time immediately. On the display: press once (SEt), then twice quickly to force sync.

Manual motor control

          
Manual mode suspends automatic control of all zones until turned off. Drive to a valve position, or run a timed open/close (1–45 s) with endstop detection still armed.

Device

          
Destructive service actions for this manifold. Identity lives under the device menu; restart and probe-map reset stay here.
Read more

          

            
            
Reset the probe map?
Deletes the saved probe assignment. Probes must be assigned again on the manifold and on each zone.

            
Restart the device?
No settings are lost. The device is away for about 10 s, and the valves hold position.
